KdVPlan.UB 0 a (a+τ) (fun t=>KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f t)) (C*τ*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) ∧
(∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Icc a (a+τ))), KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f) t)) (C*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w)) ∧
KdVPlan.XPath 0 a (a+τ) (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f)) ∧
KdVPlan.Xnorm a (a+τ) (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f) (KdVPlan.dt (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f))≤C*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w ∧
KdVPlan.UB (-KdVPlan.pstar) a (a+τ) (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f) (C*τ*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w)

intro M hM
rcases yui_aux_0023 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 M hM with ⟨Cb,hCb,hb⟩
rcases yui_aux_0020 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 M hM with ⟨Cf,hCf,hf⟩
rcases yui_aux_0050 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 M hM with ⟨Cw,hCw,hw⟩
rcases yui_aux_0070 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 M hM with ⟨Cy,hCy,hy⟩
let Cd := Cb+Cf+Cw
refine ⟨Cy+Cd,by dsimp [Cd]; positivity,?_⟩
intro a τ f w hs
have hBI := hb a τ f w hs
have hFF := hf a τ f w hs
have hWW := hw a τ f w hs
have hYY := hy a τ f w hs
rcases hs with ⟨_,ha,hτ,hτ1,hfd,hwd,hfs,hws,hwM,hd1⟩
have hab : a≤a+τ := by linarith
have hq : 0≤KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w := add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hτ.le gamma) ((yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 0 (f-w))
have hCd : 0<Cd := by dsimp [Cd]; positivity
have hW := hWW a ⟨le_rfl,hab⟩
have hWbound : KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f) (Cw*τ*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  refine ⟨hW.2.1,?_⟩
  linarith [hW.2.2,(yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 0 (KdVPlan.Qst a f a)]
have h52 := yui_aux_0052 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a τ f hτ (by simpa using hfs 1) hfd.2.1 hW.2.1
let D : KdVPlan.Path := fun t=>KdVPlan.B t f (KdVPlan.F a f t)+KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.F a f t) (KdVPlan.F a f t))-KdVPlan.scale ((τ:ℂ)⁻¹) (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f)
have hDc : KdVPlan.ContH 0 a (a+τ) D := h52.2.1
have hId := yui_aux_0071 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hA := yui_aux_0069 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hInv := (yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.1
have hNormInv : ‖(τ:ℂ)⁻¹‖=τ⁻¹ := by simp [norm_inv,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hτ]
have hInvDb : KdVPlan.UB 0 a (a+τ) (fun t=>KdVPlan.invD (D t)) (Cd*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  intro t ht
  have hB := hBI t ht
  have hF := hFF t ht
  have hIF := hInv 0 _ hF.1
  have hIF' : KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.F a f t) (KdVPlan.F a f t))) (Cf*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := ⟨hIF.1,hIF.2.trans hF.2⟩
  have hIW := hInv 0 _ hWbound.1
  have hIW' : KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f)) (Cw*τ*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := ⟨hIW.1,hIW.2.trans hWbound.2⟩
  have hhalf := hA.2.1 0 _ _ (1/2) hIF'
  have hinv := hA.2.1 0 _ _ ((τ:ℂ)⁻¹) hIW'
  norm_num at hhalf
  rw [hNormInv] at hinv
  have he : τ⁻¹*(Cw*τ*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w)=Cw*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w := by field_simp
  rw [he] at hinv
  have hh := (hA.1 0 _ _ _ _ ((hA.1 0 _ _ _ _ hB hhalf).1) hinv).2
  have heq : KdVPlan.invD (D t)=KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.B t f (KdVPlan.F a f t))+KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.F a f t) (KdVPlan.F a f t)))-KdVPlan.scale ((τ:ℂ)⁻¹) (KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f)) := by
    dsimp [D]; rw [(hId.1 _ _).2,(hId.1 _ _).1,hId.2.1,hId.2.1]
  change KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.invD (D t)) _
  rw [heq]
  exact ⟨hh.1,by dsimp [Cd]; nlinarith [hh.2,mul_nonneg hCf.le hq]⟩
have hIcY1 := (yui_aux_0039 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2 a (a+τ) _ h52.1
have hIcD1 := (yui_aux_0039 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2 a (a+τ) D hDc
have hIcY := (yui_aux_0038 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 1 a (a+τ) _ (by norm_num) hIcY1
have hIcD := (yui_aux_0038 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 1 a (a+τ) _ (by norm_num) hIcD1
have hYzero := (yui_aux_0051 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a τ f).2.2.2
have hIYzero : KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f a)=0 := by rw [hYzero]; funext k; simp [KdVPlan.invD]
have hIYder := hId.2.2 a (a+τ) (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f) D h52.2.2.1
have hIY := yui_aux_0072 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 0 a (a+τ) (Cd*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) _ _ hab (mul_nonneg hCd.le hq) hIcY hIcD hInvDb hIYzero hIYder
have hIY' : KdVPlan.UB 0 a (a+τ) (fun t=>KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f t)) (Cd*τ*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left,mul_comm,mul_left_comm,mul_assoc] using hIY
rcases h_T005.1.1 with ⟨C,hC,hBasic⟩
have hneg : ∀ A : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.ZeroMean A → KdVPlan.MemH 0 (KdVPlan.invD A) →
KdVPlan.HB (-KdVPlan.pstar) A (KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD A)) := by
  intro A hz hm
  exact (hBasic.2.2.2 0 A 0 hz hm (by simp [KdVPlan.MemH])).1
have hzD : ∀ t, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (D t) := by
  intro t
  simp [D,KdVPlan.ZeroMean,KdVPlan.scale,KdVPlan.B,KdVPlan.S,KdVPlan.dx,KdVPlan.Wst,KdVPlan.Qst,KdVPlan.timeInt,KdVPlan.rem,KdVPlan.remWith]
have hDb : KdVPlan.UB (-KdVPlan.pstar) a (a+τ) D (Cd*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  intro t ht
  have h := hneg (D t) (hzD t) (hInvDb t ht).1
  exact ⟨h.1,h.2.trans (hInvDb t ht).2⟩
have hnegY : KdVPlan.UB (-KdVPlan.pstar) a (a+τ) (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f) (Cd*τ*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  intro t ht
  have h := hneg _ ((yui_aux_0051 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a τ f).2.1 t) (hIY' t ht).1
  exact ⟨h.1,h.2.trans (hIY' t ht).2⟩
have hDcneg := (yui_aux_0038 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 (-KdVPlan.pstar) 0 a (a+τ) D (by norm_num [KdVPlan.pstar]) hDc
have hX := yui_aux_0047 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a (a+τ) (Cy*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) (Cd*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f) D hab (mul_nonneg hCy.le hq) (mul_nonneg hCd.le hq) h52.1 hDcneg hYY hDb h52.2.2.1
refine ⟨?_,?_,hX.2.1,?_,?_⟩
· intro t ht
  exact ⟨(hIY' t ht).1,(hIY' t ht).2.trans (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCy.le hτ.le) hq])⟩
· filter_upwards [hX.1,ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t he ht
  rw [he]
  exact ⟨(hInvDb t ht).1,(hInvDb t ht).2.trans (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hCy.le hq])⟩
· nlinarith [hX.2.2]
· intro t ht
  exact ⟨(hnegY t ht).1,(hnegY t ht).2.trans (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCy.le hτ.le) hq])⟩
